about: Shows the current workspace, project or environment in a control that opens a menu of the others. The control is a menu trigger, so the roles, the keys and the positioning are the menu's.

opened.about: The control at a sidebar's width with its menu open. Each workspace has a row with its initial, its name and its plan, and the suspended workspace is disabled. A separator divides the workspaces from two actions. The menu is as wide as its rows and at least 176 pixels wide, whatever the control's width.
opened.title: Open

placement.about: At the head of a sidebar the control fills the column. In a toolbar it is as wide as its words and hides the detail. Both render in the subtle look, so the control's width shows.
placement.title: Placements

title: Switcher

toolbar.about: An environment switcher in a toolbar, rendered through `Toolbar.Item`, so it is one of the row's arrow-key stops. The menu is open.
toolbar.title: In a toolbar

variant.about: The three looks at the three sizes. At rest, `plain` has no fill and `subtle` has a muted fill. `outline` adds an edge. Hover, press and an open menu fill each look darker.
variant.title: Looks and sizes
